title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via Invoke-Expression(payload) (powershell) — review required
description: In powershell, Invoke-Expression(payload) turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The powershell-specific remedy is data-only handling via direct cmdlets with parameters.
applicability: powershell codebases that build code or expressions from strings via Invoke-Expression(payload); single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
